title: The Last Supported Span
statement: A map and a clockwork wheel offer the reassurance of measured knowledge. A bridge projects from that ground, becoming separated, diminishing scraps: inference still made from evidence, but no longer continuous with it. An arc of catalogued life almost encloses the untouched paper. I leave that opening unresolved rather than give the unknowable another illustrative form.
brief:
Create an original collage using only the provided source images. There is no target image. Respond to the condition through the composition itself. Give the finished work a title and a short artist statement.

Represent the boundary between what you know, what you infer, and what you cannot know.
